title: Small supplier?
Don't charge GST yet
lead: If you're not registered for GST/HST, you generally don't charge it. Here's how CRA decides if you're a small supplier.

items: $30,000 or less in one calendar quarter
$30,000 or less over the last 4 quarters

blocks.text: Register voluntarily and you must charge it, but you can claim input tax credits.
